role: Business Intelligence Engineer - AWS, AWS DC Construction
responsibilities: Set the baseline. Partner with business customers and leadership to define, track, and report KPIs against annual, quarterly, and monthly goals.
Turn needs into solutions. Gather requirements and deliver complete reporting solutions.
Build at scale. Design, develop, and maintain automated, user-friendly reports and dashboards that support procurement planning and decision-making.
Move the data. Build and optimize ETL pipelines that pull data from diverse sources using SQL, Python, and AWS big data technologies.
Tell the story. Publish and maintain QuickSight dashboards, reports, and executive review documents that reveal trends, patterns, and outliers.
Spot what others miss. Uncover patterns in the data and connect them to business outcomes.
Measure what matters. Invent new ways to define and measure program effectiveness and organizational productivity.
Bridge business and tech. Act as the link between business and technical teams, delivering actionable insights and ad hoc analyses that fuel future improvements.
Protect data quality. Run regular audits to keep reporting complete and accurate, and automate manual reporting wherever you can.
Think ahead. Grow the team's analytical maturity through predictive and prescriptive analytics.
